facts.text: I am looking to upgrade my camera flash.

I am concerned that using a soft cloth and some cleaning solution can leave streaks or scratches on my lens.
I am thinking of getting a new tripod.
The tripod I am considering is the Gitzo GT3543LS.
I am interested in learning more about the G-Lock Ultra system.
